SELECT a.Abbreviation, a.Country
FROM airlines a
JOIN (
    SELECT Airline, COUNT(*) AS flight_count
    FROM flights
    GROUP BY Airline
    ORDER BY flight_count ASC
    LIMIT 1
) f ON a.uid = f.Airline; 
FINAL SQL:
SELECT a.Abbreviation, a.Country
FROM airlines a
JOIN (
    SELECT Airline, COUNT(*) AS flight_count
    FROM flights
    GROUP BY Airline
    ORDER BY flight_count ASC
    LIMIT 1
) f ON a.uid = f.Airline;
